title: Work-Tape Head Position Bound
statement: Let $M$ be a machine and $C$ a contract for $M$. For any data value $i$, configuration $d$, natural number $u$ with $u\\le C$’s assigned running time at $(i,d)$, and work-tape index $j$, the head position of tape $j$ after $u$ steps lies in the interval from its initial position minus $C$’s assigned running time to its initial position plus that running time, inclusive.
hypotheses_covered: $u$ is a natural number with $u\\le C$’s assigned time at $(i,d)$
replaced:
Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, and let $C$ be a contract
for $M$ on a fixed input. For any contract parameter $i$, starting configuration $d$,
natural number $u$ with $u \le C$'s running time on $i$ and $d$, and work-tape index
$j$, the head position of tape $j$ after $u$ steps lies between its initial position
minus that running time and its initial position plus that running time, inclusive.
